title: Coastal versus offshore marine heatwaves
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), compare marine heatwaves in the coastal upwelling band with those offshore: their frequency, intensity, duration and timing, and whether coastal upwelling buffers or delays them. Justify your heatwave definition and baseline.
